robot.action: a in [-1, 1]^2 -> command (a0 * v_max, a1 * w_max)

actuator.model: calibrated command model (delay, first-order lag, gains, wheel saturation)

noise.model: datasheet uniform: error ~ U(+-a(d) * d), then cap
noise.seeding: per episode, acquisition physics tick and beam (see random_seeds)

lidar.geometry_note: beam b of lidar row k points at origin_yaw[k] + beam_angle_rad[b] from (origin_x, origin_y)[k]

sensing.note: lidar.npz: fresh = a scan was acquired at this step; beam_acquired / beam_t_acq give the per-beam acquisition flag and time (all beams at the scan time here). Adaptive temporal / spatial / spatiotemporal sensing varies these per beam (and may add an event log).

terminations.clearance: footprint clearance = distance to the nearest wall / active obstacle - footprint radius

random_seeds.note: counter-based (st_nav/crng.py): episode_seed = key(env seed, env index, episode number); obstacle draws = uniform(obstacle_seed, stream, obstacle, counter); LiDAR noise of beam b acquired at physics tick t = uniform(lidar_noise_seed, t, b)

timebase: t_sim = simulated seconds since reset; trajectory / lidar / obstacles row k = after step k (row 0 = reset); steps row k = step k
lidar_rows_note: ranges = the observation the policy received after step k (row 0: reset observation; last row NaN: the terminal state is not observed); ranges_clean = noise-free ranges at the end of step k for every row; origin_* = sensor pose when `ranges` was acquired (terminal row: the pose of ranges_clean)

files.metadata.json: episode, outcome, seeds, robot, actuator, LiDAR, sensing, moving obstacles, DR flags
files.world_geometry.json: all walls of this episode (cx, cy, length, thickness, yaw) and moving-obstacle paths
files.trajectory.csv: row k = robot state after step k (row 0 = reset): pose, base_link velocity, goal distance, clearance
files.steps.csv: row k = step k: policy action in [-1, 1], command (m/s, rad/s), actuator output, reward terms, sensing, done
files.lidar.npz: row k = scan of the observation after step k: ranges (observed, noisy; NaN where not observed), ranges_clean, per-beam acquisition time/flag, sensor origin pose at acquisition
files.obstacles.npz: moving obstacles: ids, radius, active, x/y per row (row k = after step k)
